exam_scheme.note: The Jharkhand Excise Constable Competitive Examination (JECCE) is conducted in three sequential stages: (1) Physical Efficiency Test (PET / शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षण) which is qualifying in nature; (2) Written Examination (लिखित परीक्षा) consisting of 3 objective papers of 2 hours duration each on OMR sheets (+3 marks per correct answer, -1 mark penalty per wrong answer); and (3) Medical Examination (चिकित्सीय जाँच) conducted for candidates 3 times the vacancies. Paper 1 is qualifying (30% threshold required; marks do not count towards merit). Final merit list is determined by the aggregate score of Paper 2 (Tribal/Regional Language, 300 marks) and Paper 3 (General Knowledge, 360 marks), totaling 660 marks.

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: Physical Efficiency Test (PET / शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षण)

papers.paper_name: Physical Measurement & Endurance Run (शारीरिक माप एवं दौड़)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Males: 10 km run in 60 minutes; Females: 5 km run in 40 minutes. Height: UR/EWS/BC 160 cm, SC/ST 155 cm, Female 148 cm. Chest: UR/EWS/BC 81 cm, SC/ST 79 cm. Qualifying only; no marks awarded.

papers.paper_name: Paper 1: भाषा ज्ञान (Language Knowledge — Hindi 80 Qs, English 40 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: -1 mark per wrong answer (+3 for correct)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 30% (minimum 108 marks out of 360 required to qualify. Marks do not count for merit ranking)

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: क्षेत्रीय एवं जनजातीय भाषा ज्ञान (Regional & Tribal Language)
papers.negative_marking: -1 mark per wrong answer (+3 for correct)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 30% (minimum 90 marks out of 300 required; marks count towards final merit list)

papers.paper_name: Paper 3: सामान्य ज्ञान (General Knowledge — GS 40 Qs, Jharkhand GK 50 Qs, Science 20 Qs, Math 10 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: -1 mark per wrong answer (+3 for correct)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 30% (minimum 108 marks out of 360 required; marks count towards final merit list)
Conducted for candidates 3 times the notified vacancies by district medical board. Assesses physical and mental fitness, colour blindness, night blindness, hearing, and physical defects.

financial_package.note: Pay scale follows Jharkhand State Revised Pay Rules 2017 Level 2 (PB-1 ₹5,200–20,200 with Grade Pay ₹1,900, entry basic pay ₹19,900) for Excise Constables (उत्पाद सिपाही) in the Department of Excise and Prohibition, Government of Jharkhand.
financial_package.pay_source_label: JSSC JECCE-2023 Advt. No. 06/2023 Brochure, Kandika 4 (Page 4)
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary calculated from Level 2 basic ₹19,900 + 58% DA (₹11,542) + state HRA (8%–18% depending on posting location) + medical allowance (₹1,000) + uniform washing & enforcement field allowances. In-hand estimate accounts for statutory deductions of 10% NPS on Basic + DA (₹3,144), professional tax, and state employee group insurance.
